data: Does the blue line, on the left graph, reach a higher value than the red line at the x-axis value of 10,000?

The question asks whether the blue line reaches a higher value than the red line at the x-axis value of 10,000. From the analysis of the left graph, we can see that both lines start at approximately the same point around 0.1 on the y-axis and then increase. At the x-axis value of 10,000, the blue line is below the red line. Therefore, the blue line does not reach a higher value than the red line at this point.
